name: calculate_infrastructure_exposure
description: Calculate which infrastructure assets are exposed to a hazard, climate, or risk threshold, usually from an asset-hazard sample layer.

input_artifact.description: Required asset-hazard sample artifact containing one GeoJSON feature per asset and a numeric sampled value column.

value_column.description: Numeric column used to evaluate exposure. If omitted, uses input_artifact.value_column or sampled_hazard_value.

threshold.description: Numeric exposure threshold, such as 30 extreme heat days or 0.5 meters flood depth.

comparison_operator.description: Threshold comparison operator. Supported values: >, >=, <, <=, ==, !=, plus aliases like above, at_least, below, at_most.

asset_name_column.description: Optional column containing asset names. If omitted, the function tries common fields like asset_name, name, facility_name, school_name, hospital_name, port_name, or substation_name.

asset_id_column.description: Optional column containing stable asset IDs. If omitted, the function tries common fields like asset_id, id, facility_id, school_id, hospital_id, port_id, substation_id, or osm_id.

asset_type_column.description: Optional column containing infrastructure type/category. If omitted, the function tries common fields like asset_type, type, category, sector, or class.

group_by_column.description: Optional column used to summarize exposure by group. If omitted, asset_type_column is used when available.

include_unexposed_assets.description: If true, keep assets that do not meet the exposure threshold. If false, return only exposed assets.

include_missing_value_assets.description: If true, keep assets with missing exposure values. If false, drop them.

return_geometry_format.description: Geometry output format. Currently only GeoJSON is supported.

artifact_type.description: Usually infrastructure_exposure_layer. Can also be infrastructure_exposure_failed.

input_artifact_type.description: Artifact type of the input asset-hazard layer.

input_layer_id.description: Layer ID of the input artifact.

layer_id.description: Generated layer ID for the infrastructure exposure output.

group_by_column.description: Column used for group-level exposure summary.

value_column.description: Main downstream value column. Usually exposure_score.

source_value_column.description: Original sampled hazard/risk value column used for thresholding.

threshold.description: Numeric threshold used to define exposure.

geojson.description: GeoJSON FeatureCollection with asset-level exposure columns.

asset_count.description: Total number of assets in the output.

evaluated_asset_count.description: Number of assets with non-missing values evaluated against the threshold.

exposed_asset_count.description: Number of evaluated assets that meet the exposure threshold.

unexposed_asset_count.description: Number of evaluated assets that do not meet the exposure threshold.

missing_value_count.description: Number of assets with missing exposure values.

exposure_fraction.description: Exposed asset count divided by evaluated asset count.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minx, miny, maxx, maxy].

group_summary.description: Exposure summaries by asset type or requested grouping column.

provenance.description: Information about threshold, operator, and parent artifact.
